title: Nutritious New England Italian Fish Orecchiette
description: A rich and flavorful pescatarian dish featuring flaky fish, dried mint, and a medley of New England-inspired ingredients. This orecchiette recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the orecchiette pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the salmon fillet to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Remove the salmon from the skillet and set aside.
Add the crushed dried mint and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the white wine and chicken broth to the skillet and cook until the liquid has reduced by half.
Stir in the parmesan cheese until melted.
Return the cooked orecchiette pasta to the skillet and toss with the mint-infused sauce.
Serve the pasta hot, topped with the cooked salmon and chopped parsley.
Garnish with lemon wedges on the side.
